texts.preamble: Radheshyam @ Sitaram vs Nagar Palik Nigam Indore Through Food ...
texts.arguments: At this juncture, Counsel for the petitioner prays for grant of suspension of jail sentence of petitioner Radheshyam vide I.A.No.1790/2016. Counsel for the appellant has vehemently urged the fact that it was a case of false implication. Counsel submitted that the petitioner was on bail during the trial and he has not misused the [LEAKAGE_MASK] to him and the petitioner has full chance of success in the revision. Moreover, Counsel submitted that a short sentence of one year R.I. has been imposed for offence under Sections 7(1) read with 16(1)(a)(1) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act. Hence,Counsel prayed that the application be allowed. Counsel for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the submissions put forth by the Counsel for the petitioner and prayed for dismissal of the application.
